debris_flow.title: Post-Fire Debris-Flow Hazard Assessments (basins)
notes: No current USGS post-fire assessment covers this location. USGS only assesses recently burned areas, so this does not mean there is no debris-flow risk.
debris_flow.disclaimer: Assessments represent conditions immediately after the fire and do not predict downstream impacts, runout paths or inundation extent.
